components.name: Primary button
components.description: Primary button extracted from the implemented TRACE surface.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { font-family:"Apple SD Gothic Neo","Noto Sans KR","Malgun Gothic",sans-serif; display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;padding:12px 20px;min-height:46px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:11px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;background:var(--primary,#2b6f60);color:white;cursor:pointer;transition:background .16s; } .ds-button-primary:hover {background:#235d50;} .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--primary,#2b6f60); outline-offset:3px; }.ds-button-primary:disabled {opacity:.48;cursor:not-allowed;} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {.ds-button-primary {transition:none;}}

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Secondary button extracted from the implemented TRACE surface.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { font-family:"Apple SD Gothic Neo","Noto Sans KR","Malgun Gothic",sans-serif; display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;padding:12px 20px;min-height:46px;border:1px solid #dce2d8;border-radius:11px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;background:white;color:#525d50;cursor:pointer;transition:background .16s; } .ds-button-secondary:hover {background:#e7ece4;} .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--primary,#2b6f60); outline-offset:3px; }.ds-button-secondary:disabled {opacity:.48;cursor:not-allowed;} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {.ds-button-secondary {transition:none;}}

components.name: Text field
components.description: Text field extracted from the implemented TRACE surface.
components.css: .ds-field {font-family:"Apple SD Gothic Neo","Noto Sans KR","Malgun Gothic",sans-serif; width:100%;min-height:44px;border:1px solid #e1e5df;border-radius:10px;background:white;color:#3b423c;font-size:13px;padding:11px 13px;line-height:1.45;transition:border-color .16s,background .16s;} .ds-field::placeholder {color:#667065;} .ds-field:hover {border-color:#a8beb2;} .ds-field:focus {border-color:var(--mint,#54b3a6);} .ds-field:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--primary,#2b6f60); outline-offset:3px; }@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-field{transition:none;}}

components.name: Active navigation

components.name: Editable goal chip
components.description: Editable goal chip extracted from the implemented TRACE surface.
components.css: .ds-chip {font-family:"Apple SD Gothic Neo","Noto Sans KR","Malgun Gothic",sans-serif; display:inline-flex;background:var(--mint-soft,#cfefea);border-radius:10px;color:var(--primary,#2b6f60);max-width:100%;} .ds-chip button {font:inherit;background:none;border:0;padding:9px 12px;text-align:left;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;} .ds-chip button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--primary,#2b6f60); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Numbered section box

narrative.overview:
TRACE carries the supplied dashboard and sidebar references into a Korean teaching workspace: a deep green navigation rail, warm gray page, white rounded panels, and mint selected states. The system favors clear labels and compact operational controls over decorative imagery.

This document records the implemented reusable visual vocabulary in src/index.css and src/app.css. The specific three-step assignment composition remains in docs/surface-brief.md; it is not a required composition for every future screen.
keyCharacteristics: Deep green navigation with a charcoal active item.
Warm gray canvas, white panels, and restrained mint selection.
Compact Korean labels and visible keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Selection Rule
rules.body: Use deep green for primary actions and mint for selected or completed supporting controls. Keep the active navigation item charcoal.

rules.name: The Reading Order Rule
rules.body: Keep actions after the form in document flow; the final footer override is relative, not sticky.

rules.name: The Overlay Depth Rule
rules.body: Keep ordinary panels flat; reserve shadows for dialogs and transient notifications.

dos: Do preserve the supplied reference palette and rounded panel language.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and honor reduced-motion preferences.
Do retain text labels alongside evaluation colors.
donts: Don't invent a new palette or component family beyond the supplied references.
Don't promote the current three-step form composition into a requirement for unrelated screens.
Don't reuse the superseded low-contrast supporting text values.
